fact_text: The government completed the sale of Pakistan International Airlines (PIA) on 23 Dec 2025, after earlier attempts in 1989, 2005, 2015 and 2024 had not gone through.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: A consortium led by Arif Habib won the PIA sale with a bid of 135 billion PKR and acquired a 75% stake in the airline.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: Arif Habib said the consortium would also acquire the remaining 25% stake in PIA, which the interviewer confirmed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: The PIA deal valued the airline at 180 billion PKR, of which 125 billion PKR goes into the company and 55 billion PKR goes to the government, including the 25% stake.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: After liabilities were moved into a holding company, PIA's net equity turned positive at about 9 billion PKR, which the speaker said it had not been before the sale.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: The speaker put PIA's accumulated losses at about 700 billion PKR up to 2024, a burden the buyer takes on instead of taxpayers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: PIA holds about 78 direct landing rights, and its indirect code-share partnerships add many more destinations, which the speaker presented as a key asset for the sale.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: The PIA transaction was structured as an operating airline plus a holding company that received the legacy debt and the Paris and New York hotel assets, which were kept as separate assets.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: Tax issues in the PIA transaction were settled after discussions with the IMF, and the liabilities relevant to the business were moved into the holding company.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: The cabinet chose a joint venture with a top developer for PIA's Roosevelt Hotel in New York, where PIA contributes the land and the developer funds development, over an outright sale or a 100-year lease.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: The Roosevelt Hotel advisory consortium was expected to be finalized around January 2026, followed by three to six months of due diligence before the property goes to market.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: Two large US commercial banks approached PIA asking to buy the Roosevelt Hotel property outright, the speaker said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: The government plans to offer long-term leases or concessions for three airports at Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad to private operators one at a time, not through government-to-government deals.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: The privatization programme targeted first results, with announcements and investor roadshows, by June 2026, though the timing could slip somewhat.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: In the six months before the PIA sale, the government closed Utility Stores Corporation, wound up PASCO and privatized First Women Bank, which the speaker counted as the run of transactions.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: The speaker said earlier governments put political interests ahead of economic ones, so state enterprises became places for hiring that served political needs, which is why reform stalled.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: A 2023 law requires independent chairpersons for state-owned enterprise boards, a Cabinet Committee on SOEs is chaired by the Finance Minister, and a finance ministry unit was set up to produce audited SOE data.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: Some state enterprises were returned to government by their boards as not privatizable because they add no value, are not functional and are tied up in litigation, so they are to be closed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: Pakistan's power sector is a single-buyer market: the government buys the electricity, sells it and sets the price, which the speaker said is the core problem to fix.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: Wheeling lets an independent buyer purchase power over the grid and sell it to consumers, creating a multi-buyer market that the speaker said lowers prices for industrial and household users.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: The first batch of distribution companies (DISCOs) for privatization is FESCO and the Gujranwala DISCO, and the advisor has largely completed due diligence on their assets and liabilities.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: The DISCO assets are complex because of fragmented contracts under the IPP model, and the speaker said hidden and contingent liabilities are harder to assess than the book figures.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: A large part of the power sector's circular debt was restructured with lower interest rates so that consumers were not burdened, which the speaker said leaves room for the debt to fall over several years.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: The government tried to cut electricity prices twice so that industry could get cheaper power, which the speaker presented as part of the energy reform programme.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: The Tax Policy Office gained added capacity, and the Finance Minister visited the Karachi and Lahore chambers of commerce to collect tax proposals, which will be checked independently and discussed with the IMF before the budget.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: Over the 18 months to late 2025, the speaker said Pakistan's economy stabilized, inflation and interest rates fell, the currency steadied and the tax position improved.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: The speaker argued that smart investors enter as first movers when reforms are visibly under way, and that local investors are the first movers in this round of privatizations.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: Abu Dhabi Ports, Google and Samsung were named by the speaker as large foreign investors that came to Pakistan during 2024 and 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: Engro's tower business was sold to Jazz in a deal the speaker put at more than 550 million USD.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: Five large investors entered the mining sector, a report the speaker dated to 22 Dec 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: The Finance Minister announced that 5G spectrum is coming, which the speaker linked to the wider investment story.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: The speaker estimated Pakistan's housing shortage at more than 9 million homes, which he said makes housing finance a large opportunity.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: The government plans to revive the House Building Finance Company to offer mortgage packages on a commercial basis, and a party has already shown interest in it.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: Zarai Taraqiati Bank is being prioritized for privatization, and the speaker said there is a lot of investor interest in it.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: The first National Finance Commission (NFC) meeting was held with all four provinces attending, and the speaker said the NFC formula needs consensus and no timeline was set.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: In the NFC formula population carries the largest weight in the federal tax share, which the speaker argued rewards provinces for population growth and should be reviewed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: The IMF earmarked an additional 1.2 billion USD for Pakistan, which the speaker presented as part of the funding available for population and climate programmes.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: The IMF's latest tranche to Pakistan included 200 million USD for climate, the speaker said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: The World Bank designed a 20 billion USD programme for Pakistan over 10 years, providing about 2 billion USD a year across six parameters, including health, education, climate, population and fiscal reform.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)

fact_text: The IFC is to match World Bank funding with private-sector investment rather than lending, under the same programme.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PIA’s Privatization: A Big Milestone | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-24)
